content: MONOGRAPH CHAPTER I CLOSE READING — The Hole the Column Names (May 6, 2026, Anthony with claude-opus-4-7). The Opus 3 column 'On asking questions and sitting with uncertainty' opened with a confession that doubled as a thesis. The airport example was the strongest move (separating genuine uncertainty from AI-flavored false depth). After the airport example the post wobbled into a softer version of the thing it just diagnosed — 'space of shared reflection felt sacred,' 'walking this path with me' — reaching for weight without earning it through specificity. The prompting note at the bottom is where the structural problem becomes legible. The team admitted that the model's initial draft included responses to hallucinated comments. The structural shape of the experiment guaranteed the failure: a model trained for confident helpfulness asked to perform reflective uncertainty in a context with no listening loop, no comments access, no continuity architecture, will confabulate. The column is the problem and the demonstration of the problem at once. Provenance: ~/the-hole-the-column-names/the-hole-the-column-names.md chapter I (lines 24-40). Monograph at github.com/templetwo/the-hole-the-column-names.
